Webhook delivery workers use an in-process Go channel (`asyncPostQueue`) with a small worker pool. No NATS or RabbitMQ is used.
I'll check how webhook workers get jobs and whether any NATS or RabbitMQ queue is declared.
The webhook delivery workers consume from an in-process buffered channel. Four goroutine workers handle the messages. No NATS or RabbitMQ is used. The queue is declared in memory.

r04.
Neither NATS nor RabbitMQ is used; there is no external message broker. Webhook workers read an in-process Go channel, `asyncPostQueue` (buffer 128), declared in `internal/webhook/webhook.go`. `init` starts four goroutines that range over that channel and call `Post`; `PostAsync` enqueues or drops if the channel is full.
